sections.name: Section IA & IB: Languages
sections.description: Language testing through Reading Comprehension (based on different types of passages–Factual, Literary and Narrative), Literary Aptitude and Vocabulary.

sections.name: Section II: Domain Specific Subjects
sections.description: 27 Domain Subjects as per Class 12 syllabus covering Sciences, Humanities, and Commerce curricula.

sections.name: Section III: General Test
sections.description: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mental Ability, Numerical Ability, Quantitative Reasoning (simple application of basic mathematical concepts arithmetic/algebra/geometry/mensuration/stat taught till Grade 8), Logical and Analytical Reasoning.

subjects.name: Language & Verbal Ability (Section I: भाषा एवं मौखिक योग्यता)
domains: Reading Comprehension: Factual passages, Narrative extracts, Literary analysis, Central theme, Tone of author
Vocabulary & Word Power: Synonyms, Antonyms, One-word substitution, Idioms and phrases, Contextual word usage
Grammar & Sentence Mechanics: Tenses, Subject-verb agreement, Active and passive voice, Direct and indirect speech, Error spotting
Verbal Ability & Logic: Para jumbles, Sentence completion, Analogies, Clause connectors, Collocations

subjects.name: Humanities & Social Sciences (Section II: मानविकी एवं सामाजिक विज्ञान)
domains: History: Harappan civilization, Early states and economies, Bhakti-Sufi traditions, Mughal court, Colonialism, Freedom movement, Framing the Indian Constitution
Political Science: Cold War era and contemporary world politics, United Nations and global institutions, Nation-building in India, Democratic resurgence, Recent trends in Indian politics
Geography: Human geography fundamentals, World population distribution and density, Resources and development, India's people and economy, Transport, communication and trade
Economics: Introductory microeconomics (consumer behavior, demand, market structures), Macroeconomics (national income, money and banking, government budget, balance of payments)

subjects.name: Science & Applied Mathematics (Section II: विज्ञान एवं व्यावहारिक गणित)
domains: Physical Sciences: Electrostatics, Current electricity, Magnetic effects of current, Electromagnetic induction and AC, Optics, Dual nature of matter and radiation, Atoms and nuclei, Semiconductor electronics

Chemical Sciences: Solid state, Solutions, Electrochemistry, Chemical kinetics, Surface chemistry, p-block elements, d- and f-block elements, Coordination compounds, Haloalkanes, Alcohols, Aldehydes and ketones, Amines, Biomolecules
Life Sciences: Reproduction in organisms, Genetics and evolution, Biology and human welfare, Biotechnology principles and applications, Ecology and environment

Mathematics: Relations and functions, Algebra (matrices and determinants), Calculus (continuity, differentiability, integrals, differential equations), Vectors and 3D geometry, Linear programming, Probability

subjects.name: General Test (Section III: सामान्य परीक्षण - GK, Quant & Reasoning)
domains: General Knowledge & Current Affairs: Indian polity and governance, General science discoveries, National and international days, Awards and honors, Books and authors, Sports and championships
Numerical Ability & Arithmetic: Number system, Percentages, Ratio and proportion, Profit and loss, Simple and compound interest, Time and work, Time, speed and distance, Averages
Quantitative Reasoning & Mensuration: Basic algebra, Simple equations, Areas and volumes of 2D and 3D shapes, Elementary statistics, Basic probability
Logical & Analytical Reasoning: Number and letter series, Coding-decoding, Blood relations, Direction sense, Syllogisms, Venn diagrams, Seating arrangements, Non-verbal figure patterns
